newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.34 pct - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.34 pct - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.34 percent in November, down from 0.58 percent in the previous four week period, a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of Fipe, said a smaller increase in food and transport prices helped slow the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo.
Food prices rose 0.11 percent and transport prices gained 0.25 percent in the period.
Rizzieri said he expected the December Fipe index to remain more or less stable.
He gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food 0.11 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
